name: k8s datastore — the API server's etcd or etcd-readiness check reports failure
description: Fires when MIN(livespec.ci_k3s.readiness_check) for the check named etcd or etcd-readiness over the trailing 2 min is below 1. Under kine over SQLite on the datastore-tmpfs mount these names are the API server's etcd client reaching kine, not an etcd process. Single-probe on purpose, as the spec states (aligning it to 3 consecutive minutes is a spec follow-up). Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.sh (1-min timer, livespec-dev-tooling-vdleg7). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; ssh poweredge-xubuntu; kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'; journalctl -u k3s --since -30min; df -h /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
